_comment: TESTNET token registry, kept separate from tokens.json (mainnet) because they are genuinely different documents rather than two rows of one. Every address here was verified live on 2026-08-12 by reading it, not by copying a doc. Decimals were verified behaviourally: at these values the balances come out as sane numbers, where wrong decimals produce absurd ones.
_chains: arb (Arbitrum Sepolia, 421614) and near (NEAR testnet) are populated. eth, base and sol have testnet deployments but none were verified, and an unverified contract address in a balance reader means the wallet silently reports zero for a funded account.
_near: Both NEAR entries were verified on 2026-08-12 by calling ft_metadata on the contract itself, which self-reports decimals 6, and by calling ft_balance_of for an account with no storage registered, which answers "0" rather than erroring. These are the community fakes contracts: anyone can mint, so total supply is meaningless and they are worth nothing.
